中文名: 斯塔夫罗斯·哈尔基阿斯
简介: Stavros Halkias has made appearances on Adult Swim, XM Satellite radio, IFC, and the MSG Network, where he wrote and performed on the Emmy nominated, People Talking Sports and Other Stuff. He’s been featured in Tig Notaro’s Bentzen Ball, the New York Comedy Festival. Stavros is also widely known for his body-positive Instagram account and one of the three hosts of the popular podcast, Cum Town.
